notes: Chery (as distinct from Omoda/Jaecoo) sells exactly one BEV model in Australia: the Chery E5, currently one variant (Ultimate) after the entry-level Urban trim was discontinued for MY26. The Chery eQ7 is NOT sold in Australia - it is a China-domestic CLTC-rated model with no AU dealer presence, ADR compliance, or pricing; excluded. Chery's remaining AU lineup (Tiggo 4/7/8/9, C5) is petrol, HEV or PHEV ('Super Hybrid') and is excluded. Chery AU publishes only a driveaway price for the E5 ($37,990, valid 1 Jul-30 Sep 2026); no separate before-on-road-costs MSRP is brand-published. Brand's own spec sheet does not distinguish usable vs gross battery capacity (58.9kWh single figure). Braked towing capacity is not published by Chery; only an unbraked 750kg figure exists. V2L is reported as false per an AEVA technical note stating the E5 does not currently include V2X capability.

variants.priceBasis: Driveaway price (DAP), 1 July 2026 - 30 September 2026 offer window; Chery does not publish a separate before-on-road-costs MSRP for current MY26 stock
